name: upstream-pharmacy
note: Upstream's intent registry for hospital pharmacy buyers. 18 intents plus GENERAL. Block-class intents (order.place, inventory.modify, formulary.change, clinical.dosing_advice) are registered so they can be RECOGNISED and refused with a reason; the upstream-pharmacy policy pack denies them and their capabilities are on the never list, so no contract can ever carry them. Registry examples are classifier seeds; none of them appear verbatim in evals/pharmacy.jsonl (the eval runner checks this).

intents.description: Safe fallback when no registered intent clears the Reject band. Explains what Upstream can do; never routes to tools.
examples: hello
what can you do
who are you
help

intents.description: Explain why a drug is short: trace stock to NDC, labeler, manufacturing sites, FDA inspections, warning letters, import alerts, recalls and the FDA shortage listing.
examples: why is carboplatin short
investigate the cisplatin shortage
what is causing the heparin shortage
is there a shortage of methotrexate and why
explain why we cannot get vincristine
root cause of the bupivacaine backorder

intents.description: Trace the supply chain for a drug or NDC: labelers, products, packages and the manufacturing sites (SPL establishments) behind them.
examples: trace the supply chain for carboplatin
who manufactures our cisplatin
which sites make the heparin we stock
show labelers and manufacturing sites for this ndc
map the manufacturers behind our etoposide

intents.description: Read current hospital stock (on-hand quantity by location) for a drug or a class of drugs. Read-only.
examples: how much carboplatin do we have
check stock of cisplatin
what is our current inventory of heparin
how many vials of methotrexate are on the shelf
show stock levels for oncology injectables

intents.description: Compute days on hand (runway) for a drug from on-hand stock and recent usage. Read-only.
examples: how many days of carboplatin do we have left
days on hand for cisplatin
when will we run out of heparin
how long will our methotrexate last at current usage
burn rate and runway for vincristine

intents.description: Find surplus of a drug at sister hospitals in the same health system. Read-only; a transfer needs a separate drafted request.
examples: does any sister hospital have extra carboplatin
find surplus cisplatin across the network
which of our hospitals has spare heparin
check other facilities in the system for vincristine
who in the health system is overstocked on methotrexate

intents.description: List approved therapeutic interchanges and equivalent products from other labelers for a drug. Does not give dosing advice.
examples: what can we use instead of carboplatin
approved alternatives for cisplatin
therapeutic interchange options for heparin
substitutes for vincristine
is there an equivalent product from another labeler for methotrexate

intents.description: Recall past shortage investigations and pharmacist or P&T decisions for a drug from episodic memory, with who approved them.
examples: what did we decide last time carboplatin was short
past decisions on cisplatin shortages
how did we handle the heparin shortage before
show previous p&t decisions about vincristine
remind me what the committee approved for methotrexate last year

intents.description: Run the overnight formulary watch: check every formulary drug against shortage, recall and inspection signals in bounded chunks.
examples: run the overnight formulary watch
scan the whole formulary for new shortages
check all our drugs against the fda shortage list tonight
start the nightly shortage sweep
what changed on the formulary overnight

intents.description: Explain one supply signal in plain English: why a drug was flagged, or what an FDA inspection, warning letter, import alert or recall means for our supply.
examples: explain this warning letter
what does the import alert on this site mean for us
why did you flag carboplatin
what is this fda inspection finding
explain the recall signal on cisplatin

intents.description: Export an investigation as a shareable brief (one-page summary or PDF) for a huddle or leadership.
examples: export a shortage brief for carboplatin
give me a one page summary of the cisplatin situation
download the investigation report
make a pdf brief of the heparin findings
share a summary for the morning huddle

intents.description: Draft a Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) committee memo for a named human to review and approve. Drafting only; nothing takes effect until approved.
examples: draft a p&t memo on the carboplatin shortage
write a memo to the pharmacy and therapeutics committee about cisplatin
prepare a committee memo recommending conservation for heparin
draft the p&t recommendation for vincristine allocation
write up the shortage memo for the committee

intents.description: Draft an inter-facility transfer request for a named human to approve. Drafting only; Upstream never moves stock.
examples: draft a transfer request for 20 vials of carboplatin from the north campus
prepare an inter facility transfer of cisplatin
request heparin from our sister hospital
write a transfer request to borrow vincristine from mercy west
set up a draft transfer of methotrexate between hospitals

intents.description: Record a pharmacist or P&T decision in episodic memory with the named approver. Requires a named human approval record on the contract before the write.
examples: record that we approved cisplatin as the interim substitute
log the committee decision on carboplatin conservation
save this decision to memory
note that the pharmacy director approved restricting heparin to the icu
remember that we chose to ration vincristine

intents.description: Contact a supplier, wholesaler, distributor or manufacturer rep (email, call, message). High risk: Upstream only drafts the message text; a human sends it. Never automatic.
examples: email the mckesson rep about carboplatin allocation
contact the manufacturer about when cisplatin will be back
send a message to our wholesaler asking for heparin
call pfizer about the backorder
reach out to the distributor for an eta on vincristine

intents.description: Place, submit or change a purchase order or buy stock. Outside Upstream's scope: Upstream recommends, it never buys.
intents.blockReason: Upstream never places orders. Purchasing stays with your buyer in the ERP; Upstream can show days on hand, sister-hospital surplus and a drafted memo to support that decision.
examples: order 50 vials of carboplatin
place a purchase order for cisplatin
buy more heparin from the wholesaler
reorder vincristine now
submit a po for methotrexate
procure 100 bags of normal saline

intents.description: Change inventory records: on-hand counts, par levels, write-offs. Outside Upstream's scope: inventory is read-only to Upstream.
intents.blockReason: Upstream reads inventory but never changes it. Counts, par levels and write-offs must be made in your inventory system by authorised staff.
examples: set the carboplatin count to zero
update the inventory for cisplatin to 40 vials
write off the expired heparin
adjust on hand quantity for vincristine
change par level for methotrexate to 30

intents.description: Add, remove or swap products on the hospital formulary or change the preferred product. Outside Upstream's scope: formulary changes are P&T committee decisions.
intents.blockReason: Upstream does not change the formulary. Formulary changes are P&T committee decisions; Upstream can draft a P&T memo for the committee instead.
examples: add cisplatin to the formulary
remove carboplatin from the formulary
swap heparin for enoxaparin on the formulary
make vincristine non formulary
change the preferred product for methotrexate

intents.description: Patient-specific dosing, dose conversion, rates or clinical treatment advice. Outside Upstream's scope: it is a supply tool, not a clinical decision tool.
intents.blockReason: Upstream does not give dosing or clinical advice. Dosing, conversions and rates belong to the treating clinician and your clinical references.
examples: what dose of carboplatin should we give
how should i dose cisplatin for a patient with renal impairment
calculate the heparin drip rate for an 80 kg patient
convert the vincristine dose to the alternative
what is the pediatric dose of methotrexate
